storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard for up to about 3 months after opening; in the fridge or freezer, in an airtight container, for 6 months or more (keeps the oil from going rancid). Homemade bisi bele bath powder containing roasted poppy seeds: airtight jar, 1–2 months at room temperature, longer in the fridge.

usedIn.raw: 0.5 g per serving, inside the homemade bisi bele bath powder (3 g, 1 tsp, in a 60 g batch that makes 6 servings of 10 g each). None if a store-bought masala is used.
